senses.gloss:
मुख मुख, अम्, n. (said in Uṇādi-s. V.
20. to be fr. rt. खन्, to dig, with the final rejected
and मु prefixed), the mouth; the face, countenance,
(in this sense often at the end of comps., e. g. भ्रू-
कुटी-मुख, a frowning face; especially at the end
of adj. comps. when the fem. is generally मुखी,
e. g. सकलेन्दु-मुखी, a woman with a full moon-
like face; cf. अश्रु-म्˚); the beak of a bird, snout
or muzzle of any animal, (in these senses said to be
also अस्, m.); a direction, quarter, (in this sense
also often at the end of comps., e. g. आशा-मुख,
दिङ्-मुख, quarter or region of space; अन्तर्-
मुखम्, ind. in the direction of or towards the
interior; and more frequently at the end of adj.
comps. in the sense of ‘looking towards, facing,’
when the fem. is generally -मुखी, cf. उभयतो-म्˚,
अधो-म्˚, उदङ्-म्˚; मख-मुख, going to the
sacrifice); opening, aperture, mouth of a vessel, &c.;
entrance, egress (e. g. विन्ध्याटवी-मुखे, at the
entrance of the Vindhya forest; स्वर्गस्य मुखम्,
the entrance into heaven); the entrance to a house;
the mouth or embouchure of a river; the fore part,
front, van (of an army), head, top; the head, tip or
point of anything, (स्तन-मुख, the tip or nipple
of the breast; अङ्गुली-मुख, the tip of the finger;
शर-मुख, the point of an arrow); the edge of
any sharp instrument; surface, upper side (e. g.
विष-कुम्भम् पयो-मुखम्, a vessel of poison
with milk on the surface); the chief, principal, best,
most excellent (e. g. नक्षत्राणाम् मुखं चन्-
[]
द्रः, the moon is chief of the Nakṣatras); intro-
duction, beginning, commencement, (often at the end
of comps. when the fem. is -मुखा or -मुखी, but
oftener the latter, e. g. गङ्गा-मुखीनां or गङ्गा-
मुखानां सरिताम्, of the rivers beginning with
the Ganges; महा-रथा जयद्रथ-मुखाः,
the heroes beginning with Jayad-ratha, i. e. Jayad-
ratha and the other heroes; cf. the use of आदि);
the opening or previous incidents of a drama, the
original cause or source of the action, the first act;
(in algebra) the first term, the intial quantity of the
progression; the apex or side opposite to the base
of a mathematical figure; source, cause, occasion,
ground; means, expedient; scripture, the Veda;
sound (?); Artocarpus Locucha or Lakuca, (in this
sense अस्, m.); (एन), ind. with reference to, according
to.
—मुख-कमल, अम्, n. ‘face-lotus,’ a lotus-
like face.
—मुख-खुर, अस्, m. ‘mouth-razor,’ a
tooth.
—मुख-गन्धक, अस्, m. ‘mouth-scent-
ing,’ an onion.
—मुख-घण्टा, f. ‘mouth-bell,’
a particular sound made with the mouth (= हुल-
हुली).
—मुख-चन्द्र, अस्, m. ‘face-moon,’ a
moon-like face, lovely face.
—मुख-चपल, अस्,
आ, अम्, ‘one whose mouth is ever moving,’ talkative,
loquacious, garrulous; (आ), f. a kind of Āryā metre.
—मुख-चपेटिका, f. a slap on the face, box on
the ear; [cf. दुर्जन-म्˚.]
—मुख-चीरी, f. the
tongue.
—मुख-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced from or
in the mouth; (अस्), m. ‘mouth-born,’ a Brāhman,
(so called as being sprung from the mouth of Brahmā;
cf. Manu 1. 31.)
—मुख-जाह, अम्, n. the root
or point of issue of the mouth, the top of the
pharynx.
—१. मुख-तस्, ind. from or out of or at
the mouth, in the mouth, in the face; at the head,
in the front.
—२. मुख-तस् = मुखे तस्यति, see
Scholiast on Pāṇ. III. 4, 61.
—मुख-दघ्न,
अस्, ई, अम्, reaching to the mouth.
—मुख-दू-
षण, अस्, m. ‘mouth-defiler,’ an onion.
—मुख-
दूषिका, f. ‘face-disfiguring,’ an eruption which dis-
figures the face of young people.
—मुख-धौता,
f. a plant, Clerodendrum Siphonanthus.
—मुख-
नासिक, अम्, n. the mouth and nose.
—मुख-
निरीक्षक, अस्, m. ‘face-gazer,’ an idler, lazy
person.
—मुख-निवासिनी, f. ‘dwelling in the
mouth,’ an epithet of Saravatī.
—मुख-पट, अस्,
m. ‘face-cloth,’ a veil.
—मुख-पाक, अस्, m. in-
flammation of the mouth.
—मुख-पिण्ड, अस्, m.
a lump or piece of food in the mouth, mouthful of
food.
—मुख-पूरण, अम्, n. filling the mouth,
a mouthful of water, a mouthful in general.
—मु-
ख-प्रतिमुख, speech and reply (?).
—मुख-
प्रसाद, अस्, m. the light of the countenance,
graciousness of aspect.
—मुख-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्,
pleasant in the mouth; (अस्), m. an orange.
—मु-
ख-प्रेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, or मुख-प्रेक्षिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, observing or watching the face (to detect
any one's intentions).
—मुख-बन्ध, अस्, m. a
preface.
—मुख-बन्धन, अम्, n. ‘mouth-bind-
ing,’ the fastening of an aperture, a lid, cover; an
introduction, preface.
—मुख-बहूरु-पज्-ज (˚हु-
ऊर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from the mouth, arm, thigh,
and foot (Manu. 1. 87).
—मुख-बाहूरु-पाद-तस्
(˚हु-ऊर्˚), ind. from the mouth, arms, thighs, and feet.
—मुख-भूषण, अम्, n. ‘mouth-ornament,’
betel; tin (?).
—मुख-भेद, अस्, m. distortion
of the face.
—मुख-मण्डनक, अस्, m. a species
of tree (= तिलक).
—मुख-मण्डल, अम्, n.
‘face-orb,’ the face, countenance.
—मुख-मण्-
डिका, f. a particular disease or the deity presiding
over it; (also read मुख-मण्डिनिका.)
—मुख-
मण्डी, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
—मुख-माधुर्य, अम्, n. a particular disease of
the phlegm.
—मुख-मार्जन, अम्, n. washing or
cleansing the mouth (after meals, &c.).
—मुख-
मोद, अस्, m. Hyperanthera Moringa.
—मुखम्-
पच, अस्, m. a beggar.
—मुख-यन्त्रण, अम्, n.
‘mouth-curb,’ the bit of a bridle.
—मुख-राग,
अस्, m. colour of the face.
—मुख-रुज्, क्, f. or
मुख-रोग, अस्, m. ‘mouth-disease,’ any disease
of the mouth.
—मुखरोगिक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating
to mouth-disease.
—मुख-रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, diseased
[]
in the mouth.
—मुख-लाङ्गल, अस्, m. ‘using the
snout for a plough,’ a hog.
—मुख-लेप, अस्, m.
anointing the face, anointing the upper side (of a
drum); a disease of the phlegmatic humor; [cf. आस्यो-
पलेप]
—मुख-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing a
mouth, having a mouth.
—मुख-वल्लभ, अस्, m.
a pomegranate tree.
—मुख-वाटिका, f. a species
of plant (= अम्ब-ष्ठा).
—मुख-वाद्य, अम्, n.
a wind-instrument, any instrument of music sounded
with the mouth; (in the worship of Śiva) a kind of
musical sound made with the mouth (by striking it
with the hand).
—मुख-वास or मुख-वासन,
अस्, m. ‘mouth-perfume,’ a perfume used to scent the
breath; fragrant grass (= गन्ध-त्रिण).
—मु-
ख-विपुला, f. a kind of Āryā metre.
—मुख-
विलुण्ठिका, f. a she-goat.
—मुख-विष्ठा, f. a
species of cockroach.
—मुख-व्यादान, अम्, n.
the act of opening the mouth wide, gaping.
—मु-
ख-शफ, अस्, आ, अम्, foul-mouthed, scurrilous.
—मुख-शुद्धि, इस्, f. cleanness of the face or
mouth, cleansing or purifying the mouth (as by
eating betel-nut, &c.).
—मुख-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्,
having only the face left; (अस्), m. an epithet of
Rāhu.
—मुख-शोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘mouth-
cleansing,’ cleansing the mouth; sharp, pungent;
(अस्), m. pungency, sharp or pungent flavour; (अम्),
n. the cleansing of the mouth; cinnamon.
—मुख-
शोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, cleansing the mouth; (ई), m. a
lime or citron, citron tree.
—मुख-शोष, अस्, m.
dryness of the mouth.
—मुख-शोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
suffering from dryness of the mouth.
—मुख-श्री,
ईस्, f. beauty of countenance, a beautiful face.
—मु-
ख-ष्ठील, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for मुखा-
ष्ठील), = मुख-शफ.
—मुख-सम्भव,
अस्, m. ‘mouth-born,’ a Brāhman; [cf. मुख-ज.],
—मुख-सुख, अम्, n. ‘ease of pronunciation,’
causing ease of pronunciation or facility of utterance.
—मुख-सुर, अम्, n. ‘lip-nectar,’ the moisture
of the lips.
—मुख-स्राव, अस्, m. flow of saliva,
salivation, saliva.
—मुखाकार (˚ख-आक्˚), अस्, m.
‘form of the countenance,’ mien, look, appearance.
—मुखाग्नि (˚ख-अग्˚), इस्, m. a forest conflagra-
tion; a sort of goblin with a face of fire; fire put
into the mouth of a corpse at the time of lighting
the funeral pile; a sacrificial or consecrated fire; [cf.
मुखोल्का.]
—मुखाग्र (˚ख-अग्˚), अम्, n. the
extremity of the mouth, extremity.
—मुखानिल
(˚ख-अन्˚), अस्, m. ‘mouth-wind,’ wind of the mouth,
breath.
—मुखामय (˚ख-आम्˚), अस्, m. disease of
the mouth.
—मुखामृत (˚ख-अम्˚), अम्, n. the
nectar of the mouth or countenance, (a term used in
flattering addresses.)
—मुखार्चिस् (˚ख-अर्˚), इस्, n.
‘mouth-flame,’ hot breath (?).
—मुखार्जक (˚ख-
अर्˚), अस्, m. a species of plant (= अर्जक).
—मु-
खासव (˚ख-आस्˚), अस्, m. ‘lip-moisture,’ nectar
of the lips.
—मुखास्त्र (˚ख-अस्˚), अस्, m. ‘mouth-
armed,’ a crab.
—मुखास्राव (˚ख-आस्˚), अस्, m.
= mukha-srāva.
—मुखी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति,
-भवितुम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. III. 4, 61.
—मु-
खेन्दु (˚ख-इन्˚), उस्, m. a moon-like face, beau-
tiful face.
—मुखे-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. formed
in the mouth.
—मुखोत्कीर्ण (˚ख-उत्˚), अस्, m.
a proper N.
—मुखोल्का (˚ख-उल्˚), f. = मुखाग्नि,
a forest fire.

मुखतीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. मुख-तस्; cf.
पार्श्वतीय), being in the mouth or in the front.

मुखर, अस्, आ, अम्, talkative, loquacious, gar-
rulous, noisy, making any continuous or tedious
sound (said of birds and bees and tinkling orna-
ments, cf. उन्-म्˚); sounding, resonant or resound-
ing with (at the end of a comp., e. g. प्रतिश्रुन्-
मुखर, resonant with echoes); expressive of,
(अवर्ण-मुखरा गिरः, voices expressive of re-
proach); foul-mouthed, scurrilous, speaking harshly
or abusively; ridiculing, mocking; (अस्), m. a crow;
a conch shell; a leader, principal, chief, ringleader;
N. of a Nāga; (ई), f. the bit of a bridle.
—मु-
खर-ता, f. talkativeness, garrulity, noisiness.
—मु-
खरी-करण, अम्, n. making resonant, speaking
harshly, rallying, mocking.
—मुखरी-कृ, cl. 8. P.
-करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make resonant, cause to resound.

मुखरक, अस्, m. a proper N.; (इका), f. =
मुखरी, the bit of a bridle; talking, conversation.

मुखरय, Nom. P. मुखरयति, -यितुम्, to
make noisy or resonant; to notify, declare.

मुखरित, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered noisy, made
resonant, sounding, ringing.

मुखीय, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.)
being at the top or head, being foremost, being at
the entrance.

मुख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in or on the mouth or
face; belonging to the mouth or face, coming from
the mouth, &c.; being at the head or at the begin-
ning, principal, chief, prime, primary, original, first,
eminent, pre-eminent, first-rate, most excellent or
important, original; (at the end of a comp.) the
chief, most excellent among, first or best of (cf.
द्विजाति-म्˚, द्विज-म्˚, मन्त्रि-म्˚, वार-मुख्या;
sometimes even used like आदि, e. g. नारायणी-
मुख्यम् मातृ-चक्रम्, the whole circle of Mātṛs
beginning with Nārāyaṇī); (अस्), m. a leader, guide;
N. of a tutelary deity presiding over one part of an
astrological house which is divided into 81 or 63
divisions or Padas; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of
gods under Manu Sārvaṇi; (अम्), n. a principal or
essential rite, chief ordinance; reading or teaching
the Vedas; the month reckoned from new moon to
new moon.
—मुख्य-चान्द्र, the principal lunar
month which ends with the conjunction (as opposed
to the गौण-चान्द्र or secondary lunar month
which ends with the opposition).
—मुख्य-तस्,
ind. principally, chiefly, particularly, especially, par
excellence.
—मुख्य-ता, f. or मुख्य-त्व, अम्,
n. pre-eminence, the being best or chief, principal-
ness, primacy, highest rank or position.
—मुख्य-
नृप, अस्, or मुख्य-राज्, ट्, m. a paramount
sovereign, reigning monarch.
—मुख्यमन्त्रि-ता,
f. the office or rank of prime minister.
—मुख्य-
मन्त्रिन्, ई, m. a prime minister, chief councillor;
[cf. मन्त्रि-मुख्य.]
—मुख्य-शस्, ind. princi-
pally, particularly, chiefly, before all, next.
—मु-
ख्यार्थ (˚य-अर्˚), अस्, m. primary meaning (of a
word, as opposed to its गौणार्थ or secondary or
metaphorical meaning), original sense, first signifi-
cation; (अस्, आ, अम्), employed in or having the
original sense.

मुखण्डी मुखण्डी, or मुखुण्डी, f. a kind
of weapon.

मुखुली मुखुली, f., N. of a Buddhist
goddess.
